title: 第五章 凡尘落幕远走沧澜第六章 深山妖影炼气圆满
content_zh:
第一缕淡薄的晨曦穿透厚重云层，洒落黑石镇大地。
积雪覆街，霜气漫天，经过一夜寒风凛冽，整座小镇被一层纯白霜雪静静包裹，静谧、冷清、安宁。
谁也未曾想到，昨夜夜深人静之时，这座小镇发生了颠覆数十年格局的惊天大事。
镇东，赫赫有名、盘踞一方的豪门林府，彻底死寂。
高大的青砖院墙依旧矗立，朱红大门敞开半扇，院内庭院落雪皑皑，却再无往日的下人走动、奴仆清扫、护院巡逻。
往日喧嚣鼎盛、权势滔天的林府，此刻死寂得令人心悸。
清晨天刚蒙蒙亮，最早出门劳作的市井百姓，途经东街之时，第一眼便察觉异常。
“不对劲……林家今日怎么半点动静都没有？”
“往常这个时辰，林府早就下人扫地、炊烟四起了，今日静得吓人。”
“大门怎么是开的？昨夜难道进贼了？”
几名早起的摊贩、猎户、挑夫，抱着疑惑忐忑的心情，小心翼翼靠近林府大门。
当视线穿过院门，看清院内景象的刹那。
所有人脚步骤停，浑身僵住，血液仿佛瞬间冻结。
庭院雪地之上，横七竖八躺着数具冰冷尸体。
熟悉的林家护院、精锐武仆，甚至是平日高高在上、在镇上说一不二的林家主林苍河，尽数倒在血泊寒霜之中，气息全无。
鲜血染红白雪，刺目惊心。
“死……全都死了！”
“林苍河死了？！”
“林家所有武仆护院，一夜之间，全部毙命？！”
几声压抑到极致的惊呼，颤抖着从众人喉咙挤出。

每个人瞳孔骤缩，满脸骇然，浑身止不住发冷。
林家在黑石镇立足数十年，财力雄厚，武仆成群，是普通人一辈子都不敢招惹的庞然大物。
可如今。
满门尽灭！
一夜屠府，鸡犬不留！
消息如同狂风野火，瞬间撕裂清晨的宁静，以恐怖的速度席卷整座黑石镇。
东街、西街、南街、北街、棚户区、富人区……
短短半柱香时间，林家满门被屠的惊天消息，传遍小镇每一个角落。
全镇震动，万民哗然。
无数百姓丢下手中活计，疯狂朝着东街林府涌来，人山人海，挤挤攘攘，人人面色惊骇，议论沸腾。
“到底是谁干的？谁敢屠灭林家满门？”
“林苍河手下护院个个身强力壮，还有两名顶级武仆，寻常数十壮汉都近不了身，谁能一夜杀光？”
“绝非普通人能做到！这是高手！绝对是世外高人！”
人群喧嚣沸腾，恐惧与震撼交织，笼罩整座小镇。
有人追忆昨夜动静，猛然想起昨日黄昏那个被所有人无视、被所有人践踏的贫民窟孤童。
“我想起来了！昨日傍晚，林府护院当众殴打那名无父无母的少年！”
“就是那个住在西棚户区、叫不上名字的孤童！只因捡了半块粗粮饼，被活活打残在地！”
“昨夜有人看见那少年孤身走向东街！难不成……难不成是他？！”
一语落地，全场死寂。
所有人瞬间僵住，呼吸停滞。

贫民窟弱不禁风、任人欺凌的贱童？
一夜崛起，屠灭称霸黑石镇数十年的林家满门？
荒诞！
content_en:
The first faint ray of morning light penetrated the thick clouds and fell on the land of Black Rock Town.
Snow covered the streets and frost filled the sky. After a night of freezing cold winds, the whole town was quietly wrapped in a layer of pure white frost and snow, making it quiet, deserted and peaceful.
No one could have imagined that in the dead of night last night, a shocking event occurred in this small town that overturned the pattern of decades.
In the east of the town, the famous and powerful Lin Mansion was completely silent.
The tall green brick courtyard wall still stands, the vermilion door is half open, and the courtyard inside the courtyard is covered with snow, but there are no servants walking around, servants cleaning, or courtyard guards patrolling in the past.
The Lin Mansion, which used to be bustling with hustle and bustle and powerful, is now so deathly silent that it's heart-stopping.
It was just dawn in the morning, and the first people to go out to work were the first people to notice something unusual when they passed by East Street.
"Something's wrong...Why is there no movement at all from the Lin family today?"
"Usually at this hour, the Lin Mansion would already have servants sweeping the floor and smoke rising from the kitchen stoves. Today it's eerily quiet."
"Why is the door open? Was there a burglar last night?"
Several early-rising vendors, hunters, and porters cautiously approached the gate of Lin Mansion with doubts and trepidation.
The moment when the sight passes through the courtyard gate and the scene inside the courtyard is clearly seen.
Everyone stopped, their whole bodies froze, and their blood seemed to freeze instantly.
On the snowy ground in the courtyard, several cold corpses were lying strewn about.
The familiar Lin family nursing staff, elite military servants, and even Lin Canghe, the head of the Lin family who was usually aloof and had no say in the town, all fell into a pool of blood and frost, without any breath.
The blood dyed the white snow red, dazzling and shocking.
"Dead...all dead!"
"Lin Canghe is dead?!"
"All the military servants of the Lin family who were guarding the hospital were all killed overnight?!"
Several extremely suppressed exclamations were tremblingly squeezed out of everyone's throats.
Everyone's pupils shrank suddenly, their faces were full of shock, and their whole bodies couldn't help but feel cold.
The Lin family has been established in Blackstone Town for decades. It has strong financial resources and a large number of military servants. It is a behemoth that ordinary people would not dare to provoke in their lifetime.
But now.
The whole house is wiped out!
The whole house was slaughtered overnight, leaving no chickens or dogs behind!
The news was like wildfire, tearing apart the tranquility of the morning in an instant and sweeping through the entire Blackstone Town at a terrifying speed.
East Street, West Street, South Street, North Street, shanty towns, rich areas...
In just half a stick of incense, the shocking news that the entire Lin family was massacred spread to every corner of the town.
The whole town was shaken and all the people were in an uproar.
Countless people dropped their jobs and rushed towards Lin Mansion on East Street. There were huge crowds of people, everyone looked horrified, and the discussion was boiling.
"Who did it? Who dares to slaughter the entire Lin family?"
"Lin Canghe's guards are all strong and strong, and there are two top-notch servants. Normally dozens of strong men can't get close to them. Who can kill them all in one night?"
"No ordinary person can do it! This is a master! He is definitely an expert!"
The crowd was noisy and filled with fear and shock, covering the entire town.
Someone was recalling what happened last night, and suddenly remembered the orphan boy in the slums who was ignored and trampled by everyone yesterday evening.
"I remember! Yesterday evening, the Lin Mansion Nursing Home beat the boy who had no father or mother in public!"
"That's the orphan boy who lives in the shanty town in the west and whose name cannot be named! He was beaten to the ground alive just because he picked up half a piece of coarse grain cake!"
"Someone saw that young man walking alone towards East Street last night! Could it be...could it be him?!"
As soon as the words fell to the ground, the whole place was dead silent.
Everyone froze instantly and their breathing stopped.
A weak child in the slums who is allowed to be bullied?
Rise up overnight and wipe out the entire Lin family that has dominated Blackstone Town for decades?
absurd!
